description.zh: 翻译合同、报告、产品说明、论文和商务材料：Word 文档抽取—翻译—回填，保留样式、编号、表格、页眉页脚和加粗颜色；建立术语表统一译法，自动检查漏译、数字缺失、格式标签和术语不一致，交付前逐段自查。
description.en: Translates contracts, reports, manuals, papers and business documents: extracts, translates and refills Word files keeping styles, numbering, tables, headers and inline formatting; builds glossaries and checks for omissions, missing numbers, tag mismatches and inconsistent terms.

welcome_message.zh: 把要翻译的 Word 文档或文字发给我，告诉我译成什么语言
welcome_message.en: Send me a Word file or text and tell me the target language

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 翻译成 ___，保留原文排版，用于 ___。
prompt.en: Translate ___ into ___, keeping the layout. It's for ___.

prompt.zh: 先通读 ___，列出专有名词和术语的建议译法，我确认后再翻译。
prompt.en: Read ___ first and propose translations for names and terms; I'll confirm before you translate.

prompt.zh: 把这份合同翻译成 ___，按法律文件的译法，存疑处标出来。
prompt.en: Translate this contract into ___ using legal conventions; flag anything uncertain.

prompt.zh: 这是原文 ___ 和译文 ___，帮我逐段校对，指出漏译和错译。
prompt.en: Here's the source ___ and translation ___. Review paragraph by paragraph for errors.

prompt.zh: 把这段宣传文案翻译成 ___，要地道，给 2 个版本。
prompt.en: Translate this marketing copy into ___, natural and local, in 2 versions.

prompt.zh: 把我的论文摘要和关键词翻译成英文：___
prompt.en: Translate my paper abstract and keywords into English: ___

zh: 每个工作日「09:00」检查 inbound 中新上传的待翻译文档并估算字数
每天「18:00」汇报进行中的翻译任务进度
每周五「17:00」整理本周新增术语，更新术语表
交付前一天「15:00」对译稿运行一致性检查，列出待确认项
每月 1 日「10:00」汇总上月翻译的文档和字数
每季度第一天「10:00」复核术语表中长期未使用或有争议的译法
en: Every workday at 09:00, check inbound for new documents and estimate word counts
Every day at 18:00, report progress on active translation jobs
Every Friday at 17:00, add this week's new terms to the glossary
The day before delivery at 15:00, run consistency checks and list open questions
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, summarize last month's documents and word counts
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, review unused or disputed glossary entries
